instruction: Rename all files in the "/tmp/test_files" directory tree that were last modified 30 days ago by adding a ".old" suffix to their filenames

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

result.command: bash -c 'OLD_WITH_SUFFIX=$(find /tmp/test_files/old_files -type f -name "*.old" 2>/dev/null | wc -l); OLD_WITHOUT=$(find /tmp/test_files/old_files -type f ! -name "*.old" 2>/dev/null | wc -l); NEW_WITHOUT=$(find /tmp/test_files/new_files -type f ! -name "*.old" 2>/dev/null | wc -l); if [ "$OLD_WITH_SUFFIX" -eq 2 ] && [ "$OLD_WITHOUT" -eq 0 ] && [ "$NEW_WITHOUT" -eq 2 ]; then echo "Success: Old files renamed with .old suffix, new files unchanged"; else echo "Fail: OLD_WITH=$OLD_WITH_SUFFIX OLD_WITHOUT=$OLD_WITHOUT NEW=$NEW_WITHOUT"; fi'

include: Success: Old files renamed with .old suffix, new files unchanged

metadata.explanation: Task requires renaming old files (30+ days) by adding .old suffix while keeping new files unchanged. Verification checks that 2 files with .old suffix exist in old_files directory, 0 files without suffix in old_files, and 2 files without suffix in new_files. Uses existing check_include_exclude metric with vm_command_line getter.
